If Dagu READ integration is not actually wired, unhealthy, or requires privileged changes beyond the already-installed v0.1.1 helper, stop and report BLOCKED rather than improvising. The privileged boundary remains `/usr/local/sbin/mythos-hostops`.

COMPLETED only if the single live READ-only health request succeeds through the intended Dagu/Executor path and all focused tests pass. Otherwise report BLOCKED with precise evidence.
